observations: Double-door refrigerator with a top-mounted freezer.
The interior is white and appears clean; blue protective tape is still present on some components.
The freezer compartment contains one wire shelf.
The main refrigerator compartment has one shelf and a wire basket at the bottom.
The refrigerator door has two full-width storage bins.
The exterior finish appears to be a dark silver or grey.
A watermark 'SIR J ELECTRONICS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
Cardboard boxes are visible in the background, one showing 'BD-300S', though it is not confirmed to belong to this unit.

claims.evidence: Requires a phone call to the seller.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or freeze properly.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on with a thermometer inside showing a drop in temperature.

risks.risk: The brand and model are unknown, which significantly affects market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate or sticker (usually inside the door or on the back).
risks.if_unproven: as a generic or no-name brand

risks.risk: The compressor or internal components may have been repaired or replaced with non-original parts.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the refrigerator showing the compressor area.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand, model, and capacity.
Photo of the back of the refrigerator to inspect the compressor and coils.
Video of the refrigerator running and cooling.
response.reason: The brand and model are not visible in the photo. For appliances, these details are essential to establish a baseline value, as prices vary significantly between brands.
